segments.text: The Brocard circle passes through the Circumcenter X three, the Symmedian Point X six, the two Brocard points, and the vertices of the First and Second Brocard triangles. The Orthocentroidal circle has diameter from the Centroid X two to the Orthocenter X four along the Euler line.

segments.text: By Andrew Guinand's nineteen eighty-four theorem, the Incenter X one always lies strictly inside the open orthocentroidal disk—except in an equilateral triangle—revealing the deep metric boundary governed by X two and X four.
